notes: New in 1.4.16: Settings > AI agent - choose the AI provider (Venice, DeepSeek, OpenRouter or your own endpoint), the model and the thinking level; the other providers use your own key. Torrents that exist only in the newer v2 format can be added from magnet links, and a torrent added twice by different links shows as one row. Every chat is kept as a task under Tasks (top-left of the chat): reopen it later with its whole context, rename it, delete it, or start a new one.
